verdict.rationale: The docs show Factory working across connected repos: it analyzes pull and merge requests with inline comments, puts code review on autopilot across repos, tracks repository coverage, and lets you delegate a task, review the diff and merge. However, no item explicitly describes connecting a GitHub repository or the agent opening pull requests against it. Missing for 10: explicit GitHub repository connection/installation flow, documented agent-authored PR creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
